title: OAuth constant-time secret comparison correctly applied
description: src/api.rs:763-768. The client_secret comparison in the token endpoint uses subtle::ConstantTimeEq, preventing timing-based secret extraction. The ponytail comment at line 277-279 correctly explains why SQL equality on SHA-256 token hashes is acceptable (brute-forcing the hash is equivalent to brute-forcing the token). These are the right security tradeoffs for an OAuth implementation.
